title: Granite Ridge Season Pass Tariff: Committed Price, Early Commitment and Opening Money
content:
## Tariff in force for the Season Pass Programme

The figures below are the tariff the Granite Ridge Mountain Collective publishes for each season pass tier. Six figures are set per tier: the standard season price for an adult passholder, the early commitment price given where the application is recorded on or before that tier's early commitment deadline, the deadline itself, the percentage taken off the applicable price where the passholder held a Granite Ridge season pass in the preceding season, the percentage taken off where the pass is the third or a later pass bought on one household account for the same season, and the non-refundable amount taken before the pass leaves the application stage.

| Tier | Standard season price (USD) | Early commitment price (USD) | Early commitment deadline | Renewal reduction | Household reduction | Deposit (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 419.00 | 379.00 | 15 October | 0 per cent | 0 per cent | 419.00 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 629.00 | 559.00 | 15 October | 4 per cent | 5 per cent | 99.00 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 879.00 | 789.00 | 15 October | 5 per cent | 7.5 per cent | 149.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 1149.00 | 1029.00 | 15 October | 6 per cent | 10 per cent | 199.00 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 1489.00 | 1339.00 | 31 October | 7.5 per cent | 10 per cent | 249.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 1879.00 | 1699.00 | 31 October | 8 per cent | 12.5 per cent | 299.00 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 2649.00 | 2449.00 | 31 October | 10 per cent | 15 per cent | 499.00 |

### Notes on the columns

The two prices are alternatives, not a sum: a tier has one standard season price and one early commitment price, and which of them is the starting figure turns on the date the application is recorded against that tier's deadline, read as a date in the calendar year the season opens in.

The deposit is stated in USD to two decimal places. On the Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass the deposit and the standard season price are the same figure, 419.00; on every other tier the deposit is the smaller figure and stands well below the price.

The two reductions are percentages of a price, never amounts in USD. The Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass is published at 0 per cent on both, so neither reduction moves its price at all.
